mapper.select: SELECT id, invited_limit, invited_used FROM admission_counter WHERE scope_code = 'trial' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, status, expires_at FROM invite_code WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash.bytes,jdbcType=BINARY} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, wx_app_id, wx_open_id, nickname, mobile, avatar_url, status, current_plan_id, seq_no, short_id, last_login_at, mobile_bound_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{appId}, #{openId}, #{nickname}, #{mobile}, #{avatarUrl}, 'active', #{planId}, #{seqNo}, #{shortId}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{mobileBoundAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO learning_plan (id, owner_id, version_no, effective_date, change_reason, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerId}, 1, #{effectiveDate}, 'registration_default', #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE invite_code SET status = 'redeemed', redeemed_by = #{userId}, redeemed_at = #{redeemedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{inviteId} AND status = 'available'
UPDATE admission_counter SET invited_used = invited_used + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{counterId} AND invited_used < invited_limit
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_consent (id, owner_id, purpose, document_version, decision, occurred_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerId}, #{purpose}, #{version}, #{decision}, #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt})
